'''Patricia Majluf Chiok''' is a Peruvian biologist, [[zoologist]], researcher and [[Conservation movement|conservationist]]. She founded the Center for Environmental Sustainability (CSA) at the [[Cayetano Heredia University]] in 2006.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2012-05-05|title=Patricia Majluf renunció al Viceministerio de Pesquería|url=https://www.actualidadambiental.pe/patricia-majluf-renuncia-al-viceministerio-de-pesqueria/|access-date=2021-04-06|website=SPDA Actualidad Ambiental|language=es-PE}}</ref> She is currently the Vice President in Peru of [[Oceana (non-profit group)|Oceana]], a non-profit organization dedicated to the protection of the oceans.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2015-09-14|title=Patricia Majluf|url=https://live.worldbank.org/experts/patricia-majluf|access-date=2021-04-06|website=World Bank Live|language=en}}</ref>

She briefly held the position of Vice Minister of Fisheries during the [[Presidency of Ollanta Humala|Government of Ollanta Humala]], being appointed on February 25, 2012.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Perú - Patricia Majluf es la nueva Vice Ministra de Pesqueria|url=http://www.oannes.org.pe//noticias/peru-patricia-majluf-es-la-nueva-vice-ministra-de-pesqueria/|access-date=2021-04-06|website=www.oannes.org.pe|language=es-PE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2014-04-02|title=Patricia Majluf es la nueva viceministra de Pesquería de Perú|url=https://www.aqua.cl/2012/02/28/patricia-majluf-es-la-nueva-viceministra-de-pesqueria-de-peru/|access-date=2021-04-06|website=Aqua|language=es|archive-date=2021-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210413154100/https://www.aqua.cl/2012/02/28/patricia-majluf-es-la-nueva-viceministra-de-pesqueria-de-peru/|url-status=dead}}</ref> A few months later, on May 3, 2012, she submitted her irrevocable resignation from his position due to his "discrepancy and dissatisfaction about the management of the fishing sector" under the charge of the then [[:es:Ministro de la Producción del Perú|Minister of Production]] [[José Antonio Urquizo|José Urquizo Maggia]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-05-05|title=Carta de renuncia de viceministra de Pesquería Patricia Majluf {{!}} IDL Reporteros|url=https://www.idl-reporteros.pe/carta-de-renuncia-de-viceministra-de-pesqueria-patricia-majluf/|access-date=2021-04-06|website=IDL Reporteros {{!}} Unidad de periodismo de investigación.}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Majluf obtained her [[Bachelor of Science]] degree in 1980 and a degree in [[Marine biology|Marine Biology]] in 1981 from the Cayetano Heredia University, and her Ph.D. in Zoology at the [[University of Cambridge]] in 1988.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Directorio de Recursos Humanos afines a la CTI|url=http://directorio.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do;jsessionid=57d4bd94c64d7fa373590dde45c7?id_investigador=13492|access-date=2021-04-13|website=directorio.concytec.gob.pe|archive-date=2021-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422020228/http://directorio.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do;jsessionid=57d4bd94c64d7fa373590dde45c7?id_investigador=13492|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Since 1982, she has led the longest-running research program off the coast of [[Peru]], studying the impacts of [[El Niño]] and fisheries on marine wildlife populations. Since 1996 she has led marine conservation efforts in Peru, promoting the establishment of [[marine protected area]]s and developing public awareness of the large-scale ecosystem and socioeconomic impacts of industrial fisheries for Peruvian anchoveta (''[[Engraulis ringens]]'') and other extractive industries in the upwelling system of the [[Humboldt Current]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=John Simon Guggenheim Foundation {{!}} Patricia Majluf|url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/patricia-majluf/|access-date=2021-04-13|language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2006 she promoted Anchoveta Week seeking to promote the national consumption of this species and make its ecological role visible in the ecosystem of the Humboldt Current.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|last=LR|first=Redacción|date=2006-12-02|title=La Semana de la Anchoveta|url=https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/265083-la-semana-de-la-anchoveta/|access-date=2021-04-13|website=larepublica.pe|language=es-PE}}</ref> The campaign, in partnership with Peruvian chefs and restaurants, achieved an increase in human consumption from 10,000 tons in 2006 to 190,000 tons in 2012.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Patricia Majluf recibe premio Fundación BBVA por "La semana de la Anchoveta"|url=https://redaccion.lamula.pe/2012/09/26/patricia-majluf-recibe-premio-fundacion-bbva-por-la-semana-de-la-anchoveta/carmencontreras/|access-date=2021-04-13|website=redaccion.lamula.pe|language=es}}</ref> The Center for Environmental Sustainability (CSA), an institution directed by Majluf, received in 2012 from the BBVA Foundation one of the awards for the conservation of biodiversity, an award that recognizes efforts to conserve biodiversity in [[Latin America]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=lainformacion.com|date=2012-09-24|title=La Fundación BBVA entrega sus premios a la conservación de biodiversidad|url=https://www.lainformacion.com/asuntos-sociales/la-fundacion-bbva-entrega-sus-premios-a-la-conservacion-de-biodiversidad_hoA1irIsNqBDzhnK3ZM4B7/|access-date=2021-04-13|website=La Información|language=es|archive-date=2021-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210413155331/https://www.lainformacion.com/asuntos-sociales/la-fundacion-bbva-entrega-sus-premios-a-la-conservacion-de-biodiversidad_hoA1irIsNqBDzhnK3ZM4B7/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2012 she was awarded the Pew Fellowship in [[Marine conservation|Marine Conservation]] to implement a project whose objective was to reduce the industrial fishing of anchovy for the production of fishmeal and fish oil, seeking to increase direct human consumption.<ref>{{Cite web|title=La bióloga peruana Patricia Majluf recibió el premio Pew Fellowship in Marine Conservation 2012|url=https://pew.org/2xt46ea|access-date=2021-04-13|website=pew.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite press release|last=Group)|first=Pew Fellows Program in Marine Conservation (Pew Environment|title=La bióloga peruana Patricia Majluf recibió el premio Pew Fellowship in Marine Conservation 2012|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/la-biologa-peruana-patricia-majluf-recibio-el-premio-pew-fellowship-in-marine-conservation-2012-140737313.html|access-date=2021-04-13|website=www.prnewswire.com|language=en}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==

* 2006. Whitley Gold Award for Coastal and Marine Conservation.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2005-12-31|title=Marine protected areas, Punta San Juan, Southern Peru|url=https://whitleyaward.org/winners/mapping-traditional-fishing-marine-protected-areas-punta-san-juan-peru/|access-date=2021-04-14|website=Whitley Award|language=en-GB}}</ref>
* 2007. [[Guggenheim Fellowship]].<ref>{{Citation|title=List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 2007|date=2021-04-05|url=https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Guggenheim_Fellowships_awarded_in_2007&oldid=1016190113|work=Wikipedia|language=en|access-date=2021-04-14}}</ref>
* 2012. Pew Fellowship in Marine Conservation, awarded by the [[Pew Environment Group]] in [[Washington D. C.]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pew Announces 2012 Recipients of Distinguished Marine Conservation Fellowship|url=http://pew.org/1KJ2qNB|access-date=2021-04-14|website=pew.org}}</ref>
* 2013. Medal for Merits and Services from the [[Cayetano Heredia University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Directorio de Recursos Humanos afines a la CTI|url=http://directorio.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do;jsessionid=57d4bd94c64d7fa373590dde45c7?id_investigador=13492|access-date=2021-04-14|website=directorio.concytec.gob.pe|archive-date=2021-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422020228/http://directorio.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do;jsessionid=57d4bd94c64d7fa373590dde45c7?id_investigador=13492|url-status=dead}}</ref>
